failure_criteria.statement: Carve-out matches the relative string .foreman/tessera-prefix (or a suffix of tessera-prefix) and tests only send that relative file_path. Harness Write/Edit payloads with an absolute file_path still DENY. Looks done; operator still locked out.

failure_criteria.statement: Carve-out covers Write because the deny text says Write, but Edit or Bash of the same file is still denied. Matcher is unconditional Edit|Write|Bash; the operator's echo FORE > .foreman/tessera-prefix is still locked.
failure_criteria.detection: C1 names Edit and Write; C2 names a simple > redirect extract_bash_write_targets already models. A green Write-only test file does not close F2.

failure_criteria.statement: Bash sole-target check fails closed against the operator: extract_bash_write_targets returns zero targets or a false extra target, so the carve-out never fires and the named redirect is still denied. Tests that only cover Edit/Write go green.
failure_criteria.detection: C2 uses echo FORE > .foreman/tessera-prefix (and the absolute form), the same redirect class test_concept_gate.py already uses as a positive extraction case.

failure_criteria.statement: Carve-out reuses component_coupling._is_control or exempts all of .foreman/ (or any command whose text contains tessera-prefix). The named file becomes writable, so the intended fix looks done, but .claude/settings.json and other .foreman/ files open too.
failure_criteria.detection: C3 must deny Write of .claude/settings.json and Write of .foreman/other; C4 must deny a two-target Bash. Passing C1/C2 alone is not done.

out_of_scope: Dual AREM/FORE registration and dual-prefix cleanup. The ambiguous root is why the override file exists; this ticket does not disambiguate the registry.
A family-wide property that every hard gate must have a reachable self-remedy. Ticket says that is a later pass.
The two follow-up items tracked separately.
Exempting .claude/settings.json. The incident also blocked that file; the ticket names .foreman/tessera-prefix as the fix and leaves settings.json out unless argued in with an explicit amendment.
Changing tessera_resolver.resolve statuses, OVERRIDE_FILENAME, or read_override.
Widening component_coupling._is_control or CONTROL_FILENAMES so the freeze gate and this gate share a class-wide exemption.
constraints: Implementation is preflight_blocking_gate.py plus its unittest. Do not edit goals_freeze_gate.py or component_coupling.py to share the exemption.
Remedy path is exactly {project_root}/.foreman/ concatenated with tessera_resolver.OVERRIDE_FILENAME (tessera-prefix). No other filename.
Path identity is Path.resolve equality against that remedy path, not string suffix, endswith, or basename match.
Bash side reuses component_coupling.extract_bash_write_targets. Sole target means that list has length 1 and that one path resolves to the remedy file.
If the tool call cannot be shown to be that sole target, keep the existing ambiguous/unreachable DENY (fail toward closed).

This file sits at bollard/GOALS.json because that is the component root the freeze gate resolves; criteria cover this carve-out only. Do not land the other follow-up items, dual-prefix work, or other bollard changes under this freeze.
Do not treat the deny-text mention of the file as license to also exempt hook-registration files.
